description: Parse at system boundaries — use Zod or similar at entry points only
remedy: Use a Zod schema and parse/safeParse instead of raw JSON.parse in production code paths. Only parse at I/O boundaries.

description: No hand-rolled concurrency — use existing async primitives (Promise.all, p-limit)
remedy: Replace hand-rolled Promise constructors with async/await + Promise.all or p-limit for concurrency control.

description: Structured logging only — no bare console.log in src/
remedy: Replace console.log with getLogger().info() or getLogger().debug(). Only CLI entry points may use console.log for user-facing output.

description: No `as any` type assertions — use typed interfaces or unknown
remedy: Replace `as any` with a typed assertion (`as MyType`) or use `unknown` and narrow the type explicitly.
